title: Northbeam TechWorks Ledger Reading: The Labour an Attendance Surcharge Rests On
content:
The labour a surcharge on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job is worked out on is chosen attendance by attendance, from the labour entries standing on the job.

## The reading, attendance by attendance

1. Where the job carries labour for two or more attendances and a part was ordered for it, the labour booked for the day the crew was last sent out is the figure taken.
2. Where the job carries labour for two or more attendances and no part was ordered for it, the labour booked for the day the slot stands booked for is the figure taken.
3. Where neither of those situations holds, the labour standing on the job for it is the figure taken.

Two things are read from the job's service history to settle which of the three applies: how many labour entries stand on the job, and whether any part has been ordered for it. The days are read from the job itself — the day the crew was last sent out, and the day the slot stands booked for.

## The same reading as a table

| Labour entries standing on the job | A part has been ordered for the job | The figure taken |
| --- | --- | --- |
| two or more | yes | the labour booked for the day the crew was last sent out |
| two or more | no | the labour booked for the day the slot stands booked for |
| one | yes | the labour standing on the job |
| one | no | the labour standing on the job |
| none | either | the labour standing on the job |

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

*The amounts below are chosen for the illustration and are not figures of any job on file.*

**One labour entry only.** Where a single entry of 126.50 USD stands on a hypothetical job, neither of the first two situations holds, whether or not a part was ordered, and the figure taken is the labour standing on the job, 126.50 USD.

**Three labour entries, no part ordered.** A hypothetical job carries labour of 108.90 USD for an early attendance, 214.60 USD for the day the crew was last sent out, and 47.30 USD for a third; the slot stands booked for the day carrying 108.90 USD. Two or more entries stand and no part was ordered, so the second situation governs and the figure taken is 108.90 USD.

**Three labour entries, a part ordered.** The same three entries, with a part ordered for the job, fall under the first situation, and the figure taken is 214.60 USD, the labour booked for the day the crew was last sent out.
